note: Burbach camping area of Lewis and Clark SRA, next to Weigand on the south shore of Lewis and Clark Lake (the Missouri River reservoir behind Gavins Point Dam) north of Crofton: shaded back-in electric pads on two loops, plus non-electric gravel pads and 10 cabins. Coin showers, swim beach, playground and picnic shelter; the lake is behind a belt of shoreline trees. --Claude
